messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

This risk is particularly high if older adults take diuretics.
This risk is also particularly high if older adults are dehydrated.

Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

B. 'detectable in system for': The subject drug or its metabolite can be detected in the body for the duration specified by the object entity.
C. 'has duration of treatment': The subject drug is typically taken for the length of time specified by the object entity.
